modules.title: 原型能核对流程，不能证明真实业务结果

items.title: 线框图：核对页面结构
items.text: 静态展示内容和位置；不能检查按钮后的页面跳转、失败分支或返回路径。

items.title: 可点击原型：走查页面路径
items.text: 用模拟内容点完主路径、分支和恢复方式；它不访问真实服务，也不验证预约是否保存。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 可点击不等于可用业务已经完成。原型里的成功提示、编号和表单数据都可以是模拟的；数据保存、权限、时段冲突等结果需要连接真实服务后检查。

lessonPractice.title: 预约流程还没和团队对齐。现在应先检查哪一项，再接真实接口？

options.label: 用可点击原型走查选时段、填写、提交和失败返回，确认路径完整
options.feedback: 对。实际走一遍主路径和失败分支，能先检查页面跳转与恢复方式；预约是否成功仍需真实服务端验证。

options.label: 只核对每页摆放了哪些内容，不再点击跳转
options.feedback: 静态页面不能检查提交后去哪，也看不到失败时能否返回重选。

options.label: 先接真实预约接口，再用真实订单检查所有路径
options.feedback: 真实接口不是走查页面流程的前提；应先明确预期路径，且原型里的成功结果不能冒充真实订单。

en.title: The booking flow is not aligned yet. What should the team check before connecting real APIs?

options.label: Walk through time selection, details, submission, and failure recovery in a clickable prototype
options.feedback: Correct. Walking the main path and a failure branch checks navigation and recovery; only the real service can confirm an actual booking.

options.label: Check where content sits on each page, but do not click through
options.feedback: Static pages cannot show where submission leads or whether users can return after a failure.

options.label: Connect the real booking API first, then test every path with live orders
options.feedback: A live API is not required to review the page flow; a prototype's simulated success must not be presented as a real booking.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请先做一份可点击的预约原型，走查选时段、填写资料、提交成功和时段不可用后的返回路径。可以用模拟预约编号展示页面状态，但明确标注还没保存订单、也没调用真实接口；确认路径后再接服务端。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: First build a clickable booking prototype and walk through time selection, details, submission, and the return path when a slot is unavailable. A simulated booking number may show the page state, but label it clearly as not saved and not connected to a real API. Connect the service only after the flow is agreed.

learning.assumes: You have seen wireframes, or shipped code before realizing the flow was wrong.
learning.outcome: You can walk through the main path and a failure return, and identify which business results remain unverified.

modules.title: A prototype checks the flow, not real business results

items.title: Wireframe: review page structure
items.text: It shows content and placement but cannot check a button's destination, a failure branch, or a return path.

items.title: Clickable prototype: walk the page paths
items.text: Click through the main path, branches, and recovery with simulated content. It does not contact a live service or verify a saved booking.

modules.title: What it does not prove
modules.text: Clickable does not mean the business feature works. Confirmation, IDs, and form data in a prototype may be simulated; data persistence, permissions, and slot conflicts need checks against real services.

distinctions.label: Wireframe
distinctions.text: A wireframe is a static layout that cannot be clicked; a clickable prototype walks through the flow, though its content is still illustrative.

distinctions.label: Working product
distinctions.text: A finished product connects real data and logic and completes real business; a prototype only demonstrates paths with fake or empty data.
